title: Ordinary homology of the finite constant tensor model
statement: If every coefficient map φ_n is an isomorphism, then for the explicit tensor complex, the homology of its derived constant realization after coefficient transport and chart restriction is isomorphic to the ordinary constant realization of its algebraic homology.

proof.text: Since φ_(n+1) is an isomorphism, ordinary scalar change along it is an equivalence (it is left adjoint to restriction of scalars along an isomorphism, which is an equivalence), hence exact. The chosen derived change is a left derived functor of it, and so is the termwise functor on derived categories, which agrees with it on complexes; the universal property identifies the two. Applying homology, the mapped-complex homology comparison for the exact functor (ordinary change after the exact constant realization) identifies the result with the ordinary constant realization of the algebraic homology of the tensor complex; chart over-restriction preserves the isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteQuotient_layer_tensor_model_homology_identification
    (X : Scheme.{t})
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (n : ℕ) (Z : X.Etale)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1))) ℤ) (q : ℤ) :
    Nonempty
      (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
            ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (φ (n + 1))).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
                (finiteModelConstantComplex X _
                  (finiteQuotientLayerTensorComplex d.ideal n P)))))) ≅
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
          ((finiteCoefficientConstantFunctor X
            (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1)) (φ (n + 1))).obj
            ((finiteQuotientLayerTensorComplex d.ideal n P).homology q)))
